faq.question: What does Manoj Pathak do?
faq.answer: Manoj is a full-stack and Flutter developer. He builds responsive websites, SaaS platforms, backend APIs, and mobile applications, from interface work through to production delivery.

faq.question: Where is he based?
faq.answer: He is based in Kathmandu, Nepal and works with teams anywhere.

faq.question: Which technologies does he work with?
faq.answer: His primary stack is Next.js, React, TypeScript, Laravel, PHP, MySQL, and Flutter. He focuses on performance, maintainability, and accessible interfaces.

faq.question: What is his current role?
faq.answer: He currently works at Webcreation Nepal as a Full Stack Developer and Flutter Developer. He previously worked at Shakta Technology.

faq.question: How can I contact him?
faq.answer: Email manojjj123123@gmail.com or message +977 9813405728 on WhatsApp. Email is the most reliable route for detailed enquiries.
